Run a development API alongside Redis without publishing Redis externally.

Host port API service redis service · redis service Volume · Read the diagram: Host port → API service → redis service; redis service → Volume · ඉහළ visual එJක් components සහ ඒවා අතර සම්බන්ධය බලන්න. Compose YAML එකක API, database වJගේ · services define කරනවා.

services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8080:3000"]
    environment:
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    volumes: ["cache:/data"]
volumes:
  cache: {}
# docker compose up -d --build
Expected result: API and Redis share the default Compose network; API publishes a local port.
